facts.business: Dhampure Speciality Sugars Limited manufactures, processes, trades, imports and exports sugar and allied products including raw sugar, refined sugar, gur (jaggery), khandsari and related by-products, and operates in the FMCG space through wholly owned subsidiaries covering mocktails, snacks, syrups, organic groceries, gur mithai, desserts, baking products and mouth fresheners.
key_risks: Seasonal nature of sugar and jaggery business leading to quarter-on-quarter performance variation
Export policy constraints including May 2026 prohibition on sugar exports
Regulatory changes in sugar and ethanol economy
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions disclosed in Notes to Accounts under Note 27 (standalone) and Note 30 (consolidated); policy available on company website.
